IMAGE 2 is a research MOTION/LAYOUT GUIDE only: preserve each slot pose, facing, compression, face visibility, appendage and bubble positions, bound/unbound state, scale and local origin, but replace all commercial character artwork with the identity from IMAGE 1. Do not copy the donor colored pixels or recognizable donor facial design. Mint leaf-eared seed creature: coherent jade/mint green round seed, two leaf-ear surfaces, two separated cream eye caps, dark jade pupils, small peach triangular nose and short separate mouth. Keep the leafy limbless anatomy; feline identity is expressed by facial marks only, never add cat legs, tail or extra ears.
OUTPUT: exactly 8 columns by 6 rows, 48 equally sized cells, transparent RGBA canvas, no grid lines, words, labels, numbers, ground shadows, glow, background, decorations, anti-aliasing or painterly effects. Each cell represents a logical64x64 image enlarged uniformly4x for this2K sheet. Keep the character SMALL within each cell, exactly at the positions and size of image2, with broad transparent margins. Do not fill each cell, auto-center, bottom-align or resize individual characters. The same shared coordinate origin is [23, 37]. Preserve small pixel clusters and limited palette of the seed; gold rope is a separate physical prop. No motion interpolation or new actions. Retain different visible face openings, squeezed/closed faces and occlusion: do not put a smiling face on every frame. Restraint must visibly wrap the BODY in each bound pose and change orientation with it; never omit it on flattened poses. Folded leaves or swept upper body hide face exactly as the guide.
